sources.claim: Original fictional monthly simple returns in percent, supplied directly rather than calculated from price levels. No external observations, forecasts or investment advice. Pearson correlation uses only paired months in each named inclusive window. Undefined for insufficient pairs or constant series. Matrix coefficients rounded to two decimals; color represents a fixed -1 to +1 domain.
sources.source: inputs.json; fframes/correlation-data.mjs v1. Pearson method: NIST Dataplot correlation reference (see SOURCES.md).
